bug: api consumer signup-set refuses 'Stripe is not connected' even when only a free plan is offered, so a seller without a billing provider cannot open free sign-up (fix on branch fix/mcp-signup-free-plan-no-stripe)
security.txt Canonical URL ends in 404; its Encryption URL serves an HTML page, not a PGP key
custom domains are disabled on production: domains add answers 'Custom domains are unavailable ... not available on this Gregale installation right now' though the inventory lists them as GA
gregale deploy with an app's deploy token fails insufficient_scope (the CLI calls an endpoint needing admin or apps:read); the deploy API itself accepts the token

a push to the production branch of an app bound with gregale github bind created no deployment within 25 min (three runs); github status reports the binding healthy. Root cause: githubd deployed only through a project bound to the repository, which an app bind never creates (ADR-20261101160300); known until that fix is released
follows from push_to_deploy: no deployment, so no Gregale check on the pushed commit
opening a pull request on the bound fixture repository created no preview within 5 min; gregale preview create works and the preview serves

closing the pull request did not record the close (the step now checks pr_state=closed with a 24h grace; teardown after the grace is by design); root cause shared with push_to_deploy: the App webhook URL and secret were wrong (fixed on GitHub 2026-10-29) and githubd rejected every real pull_request payload (#5862), known until #5862 is released

queues and pull leases are still preview (GA row 99): gregale feature list reports them disabled until they are released to the e2e account, and the journey's other steps report blocked; remove once the owner releases them

managed prompts are part of the AI gateway preview (GA row 114): gregale feature list reports ai-prompts disabled until the AI gateway is released to the e2e account, and the journey's other steps report blocked; remove once the owner releases it

outbound integrations are still preview (GA row 115): gregale feature list reports outbound-integrations disabled until it is released to the e2e account, and the journey's other steps report blocked; remove once the owner releases it

the resumable realtime protocol (retained history, presence, occupancy, tickets) is still preview (GA row 176; core realtime is beta, row 112): realtimed offers gregale.realtime.v2 only to accounts in the realtime_preview rollout with FAAS_REALTIME_RESUME_PREVIEW_ENABLED on, and the journey's later steps report blocked; remove once the e2e account is released

managed PostgreSQL and the Data API (GA rows 109 and 110) are preview and not released to production accounts: production provisioning waits on the operator approval pin (ADR-20261028103115), and the later steps report blocked; remove once the e2e account is released

on-demand profiling is not enabled on production: gregale debug captures answers 'on-demand profiling is not enabled on this installation', and the pprof_download and delete steps then hit no such API route; remove once the owner enables it

a platform cold-boot health check reaching the old release after the rollout makes the regression detector compare the two releases side by side, where the old one has no baseline for GET /, so a 24x slowdown is not reported (ADR-127 amendment 2026-11-14); known until that fix is released. Passes when no such request lands

released apid starts an experiment's telemetry cursor at the start instant, but gateways stamp minute-collapsed request telemetry at the start of its minute, so exposures in the start minute (all of a short run) are never counted; fixed in PR #7736 (FlagExperimentStartCursor), drop once released
